plugins.name: usage-dashboard
plugins.description: Token and cost dashboard from ZCode rollout logs at ~/.zcode/cli/rollout/model-io-sess_*.jsonl. Aggregates tokens per day, per session, and per model; cost only when you supply a per-model price JSON (no hardcoded prices). Caveat: with some new-api style proxies, outputTokens reports 0 even when output was produced, so output and cost figures are lower bounds; the report says so when it detects that.
